verdict.rationale: Evidence shows consent capture/sync and PII blocking/masking/encryption (compliance toolkit), but there is no mention of a mechanism to process explicit user deletion or suppression requests (e.g., a regulations/suppression API) and propagate them to connected destinations. Missing for 10: documentation of a deletion/suppression request API or workflow, evidence it forwards such requests to downstream destinations, and any audit/confirmation trail for GDPR/CCPA erasure requests.
